yaraRules:
rule SuspiciousRansomware {
  meta:
    description = "Detects potential ransomware patterns"
    author = "Security Analyst"
  strings:
    $crypto1 = "CryptEncrypt" nocase
    $crypto2 = "CryptDecrypt" nocase
    $ransom = "bitcoin" nocase
    $file_ext = ".encrypted" nocase
    $url = /https?:\/\/[a-zA-Z0-9\-\.]+\.(onion|tk)/
  condition:
    (2 of ($crypto*)) and ($ransom or $file_ext or $url)
}

rule Keylogger {
  meta:
    description = "Detects keylogger behavior"
  strings:
    $key1 = "GetAsyncKeyState" nocase
    $key2 = "GetKeyState" nocase
    $hook = "SetWindowsHookEx" nocase
  condition:
    ($key1 or $key2) and $hook
}
